name: copy-button
useFor: Place beside a command, key or file and pass its value: in a window bar's corner, at the top right of a code card or in an install box. Use dark on ink. Use compact only where there is no room for the word.
constraints: A copy button without a label for screen readers
A key that changes width when it says Copied
documentation:
`CopyButton` takes `value`, `label` (the accessible name, default "Copy"), `dark` (on ink), `compact` (the icon only,
named by a tooltip) and `className`. It also exports `useCopy()`, which returns `{ hasCopied, error, copy }` for a
control of your own.
title: Copy button
description: A small Copy key that swaps to Copied in place, on white or on ink.
